2Anthropic IPO math: $4.6B rev, $518B infra

@ns123abc — Anthropic IPO S-1 leak: $2T target, $4.6B rev, charts.

Reuters saw the prospectus. Anthropic reports ~$4.6B revenue for 2025 (~12× YoY). The net loss is ~$42B. Planned cloud and compute obligations total $518B. Broadcom agreed to lend up to $42B for Anthropic’s TPU lease financing. Broadcom is both supplier and banker.

David Robinson led safety-report writing for product releases. He resigned. He wrote that frontier-lab culture—not only rules—must change. He cites pace and agent “swarm” incidents. OpenAI says it will pause training or hold models when needed.

Labs & research

arXiv

Cogentic · novel proofs on open TCS problems

@rohanpaul_ai — Google Cogentic: novel proofs on 5 open TCS problems.

Google Research built a multi-agent prove–verify harness on Gemini. The harness found expert-verified novel results on five open problems. The problems are in online learning and mechanism design. The proofs use natural language for humans. They are not Lean formalization.

Google Research · arXiv arXiv:2609.40324
arXiv

VISTA · perfect ARC-AGI-3 RHAE

@JoshHanHi — VISTA paper on arXiv; beyond ARC-AGI-3, game grid.

MIT built a visual harness with lossless memory. With Claude Opus 5.0 (xhigh), it hits RHAE 100 on all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games. It uses 57.4% fewer actions than first-time humans. It does not use program synthesis.

MIT · arXiv arXiv:2610.02200
arXiv

CLMs · models that edit context as a file

@arankomatsuzaki — Meta Context Language Models: context as editable file.

Meta Superintelligence Labs and collaborators introduce Context Language Models. CLMs manage context as an editable file. They beat strong baselines on long-horizon and multi-repo agent workloads.

Meta / UW et al. · arXiv arXiv:2609.37725
DeepMind Institute

Artificial Symbiotic Intelligence

@blaiseaguera — DeepMind Institute essay: Artificial symbiotic intelligence.

Blaise Agüera y Arcas argues AGI may arrive as societies of agents plus humans and institutions. AGI is not a lone singularity in this view. Alignment becomes co-evolution of hybrid networks.

DeepMind Institute · Essay Essay
Coverage

Apple clamps Full Disk Access for AI agents

@TechCrunch — Apple tightening macOS Full Disk Access for AI agents.

macOS will require very explicit user action before apps get Full Disk Access. Apple cites rising risk as desktop agents grow more capable. There is no firm ship date yet.

TechCrunch · The Verge · Coverage TechCrunch Verge

@andresvilarino — OpenAI launches virtual try-on in ChatGPT.

Hugging Face Hub crossed ~1M datasets. Usage is still concentrated. ChatGPT added a virtual clothing try-on flow. The flow is handy but still imperfect on edits.

Angola / Africa infra

Angola

Conecta Angola hub → 2Africa cable

@TrendBeatAfrica — Conecta Angola hub linked to the 2Africa cable.

GGPEN, Anyconnect, and Unitel link the Conecta Angola VSAT hub to the 2Africa submarine cable. The hub connects via ANGOSAT-2. Remote satellite traffic can then enter national and international routes. This work is distinct from Issue #1’s MONET/SACS upgrade. This design is a satellite+subsea hybrid for underserved areas (World Bank IDESA context).

Business Tech Africa · Angola Report
